# Your Dog Gets a Bath in the Driveway. You Stay on the Sofa.

Hi, I'm Jenna. For eleven years I have washed, brushed and trimmed dogs in clients' own homes and gardens. I drive a converted van with a hot-water tank, a hydraulic table and a very patient floor.

[Button: Book a visit]

## What happens when I arrive

I ring the bell, put the kettle on if you want a cup, and ask about your dog before I touch them. Any sore spots? Old injuries? A favourite toy that has to stay in the bath? Then we start. Most dogs walk straight into the van, which surprises owners more than it should.

Every appointment is one dog at a time, with no other clients waiting in the car park. Nothing is rushed. If your dog needs a break, we take one.

## What's included

- **Full bath** with dog-safe shampoo, chosen for skin type. Sensitive, puppy and allergy formulas on request.
- **Brush-out and de-matting**, done gently. If a mat is too tight to save, I will tell you before I cut it.
- **Nail trim and paw care**, including the fiddly dewclaws most groomers skip.
- **Ear clean** and a quick check for anything that needs your vet's attention.
- **Haircut or tidy-up** in the style you choose, or a sensible one if you cannot decide.

Prices start at €55 for a small dog with a short coat and go up from there. You get a fixed quote when you book, so there are no surprises on the doorstep.

## Who I work with

Small dogs, big dogs, doodles, terriers, and the golden retriever who thinks he is a lapdog. I am happy to work with rescue dogs who are still settling in, and with older dogs who find the stand a bit wobbly. I cannot safely groom dogs that are aggressive or in acute pain. In those cases I will talk to you honestly about your options, including your vet.

## Why a mobile service

Your dog does not like the shop. The noise, the smells, the other dogs waiting in the corner. Most of them relax once they are at home, and a relaxed dog is easier to groom and kinder to groom. You also do not have to lift a wet, nervous animal into the car and drive across town.

The van carries its own water, so there is no need for a hose in your garden if you would rather keep things tidy. I bring towels, dryers and a shade cloth for hot days.

## Reviews from people who have had me round

"Biscuit has never once let anyone near his ears. Jenna did them in ten minutes and he fell asleep on the mat." Sam, Ostend

"I booked for our older Labrador, expecting a struggle. She was calm the whole time, and the coat is lovely." Priya, Hausen

## Book your visit

Pick a day that suits you. I work Tuesday to Saturday, and I keep Friday afternoons free for emergency trims and for rescue dogs who need an extra hour. Send me a message with your dog's name, breed and age, and I will reply within a working day with a time and a price.
